name: Question 7
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=4-{t}^{2}$, where $t>0$ is the time  in seconds. If the particle has velocity $v=0\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=0\,\text{s},$ calculate the maximum velocity ${v}_{\text{max}}$ of the particle and determine the time when the particle reaches its maximum velocity.

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration, measured in m/s2, given by the function a(t)=4−t2, where t>0 is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity v=0m/s when t=0s, calculate the maximum velocity vmax of the particle and determine the time when the particle reaches its maximum velocity.

vmax=143m/s,t=2s
b
vmax=113m/s,t=1s
c
vmax=163m/s,t=2s
d
vmax=13m/s,t=1s
e
vmax=83m/s,t=2s
